title: The Singing Tree
text: An oak older than the rift hums one long note that goes on and on without breath. The bark around a knot is worn smooth and dark, as if many hands have pressed it. The note shivers through your teeth.

options.label: The wisest presses the worn knot.

outcomes.text: The note changes to match their heartbeat, and for a while everything is quiet inside.
The note changes to match their heartbeat, and then it stops, and so do they, for a while.
It goes on singing all the way down. The wood is very good.
The note follows you a little way, and then it lets you go. It stays in the Leader's head as a calm under everything.
